name: pinyin_convert
description: Convert Chinese characters to Hanyu Pinyin with tone marks (zhōng), tone numbers (zhong1) or no tones, from bundled Unihan readings: the 8105 characters of the Table of General Standard Chinese Characters plus every other code point with a kMandarin reading (44 355 in all). Each character gets Unihan's primary reading and lists its alternatives; optional tone sandhi for 一, 不 and third tones, apostrophes when syllables are joined, capitals. No word segmentation.

text.description: Chinese text; characters without a reading are copied unchanged

separator.description: Between syllables of a run of Hanzi; with "" an apostrophe goes before a syllable starting with a, e or o

capitalize.description: Upper-case the first letter of each run of Hanzi

sandhi.description: Apply the tone sandhi of 一, 不 and runs of third tones

umlaut.description: How ü is written in the numbers and none styles

neutral_five.description: Write the neutral tone as 5 in the numbers style

catalog.source: Unicode Han Database (UAX #38, Unicode 18.0.0): kMandarin, kTGH, kTGHZ2013, kXHC1983, kHanyuPinyin, Unicode License v3, bundled by tools/catalog/data/pinyin_convert.py; tone-mark placement and apostrophe per GB/T 16159-2012; stdlib replacement for python-pinyin (pypinyin, MIT) without its phrase dictionary
